name: Techno
summary: The mainline/classic techno lane — Detroit's 909 three-hat interplay, Berlin dub techno's unswung sparse pulse, minimal's jacking swing, peak-time rolling grooves, hypnotic ride-led loops, tribal toms, electro-adjacent broken kicks, acid-era 707/909/303 hybrids and Sheffield bleep & bass. Kick is a steady or half-time 4/4 (rarely a hard-techno gallop), percussion carries the identity role by role, and swing ranges from dead straight (dub techno) to a pronounced MPC shuffle (minimal, bleep).

sounds.kick: 909 or 707 four-to-the-floor, tuned and compressed rather than distorted; half-time or omitted in dub/minimal lanes; 808 in the electro-adjacent lane.
sounds.snare: 909/808 snare pitched down for a darker Detroit character, played as counterpoint rather than backbeat; clap doubling on 2-and-4 or on a single downbeat in dub techno; 808 snare with swing in minimal.
sounds.hats: Three-layer 909 closed/open hat interplay in Detroit style; sharp closed 16ths in minimal and acid lanes; open hat as the offbeat driver in peak-time and rolling techno; ride cymbal as the main pulse in hypnotic techno.
sounds.percussion: Congas, clave and rimshot for Latin/tribal interplay; schranz-adjacent percussion loops; cowbell and clave for the electro lane; chord-stab percussion slot for dub techno.
sounds.cymbals: Ride is a groove element (loud/soft 8ths) more often than a wash; one crash marks section changes and drops.

machines: Roland TR-909 — kick, snare, hats, ride; the defining Detroit and Berlin machine (owned)
Roland TR-808 — snare, low tom, electro-lane kick (owned)
Roland TR-707 — acid-era kick and hats, Armando-style acid house (owned)
Roland TR-727 / TR-505 — congas, claves, tribal percussion (owned)
Jomox Xbase09 / Mbase01 — analogue punch for modern peak-time kicks (owned)
MFB 502/512 — 909-adjacent analogue percussion for schranz-influenced loops (owned)
Elektron Machinedrum / Korg Electribe ER-1 — synthesised metallic percussion (owned)
E-mu SP-1200 — 12-bit resampling for lo-fi dub/electro grit (owned)
Roland TB-303 (via ABL2/ABL3 emulation) — acid basslines that sit over these drum patterns (get elsewhere)
Sonic Academy Kick 2 — synthesised modern techno kick design (get elsewhere)
